image.why: Madrid as it stood four years before the novel, in León Gil de Palacio's model of the city (Museo de Historia de Madrid)

summary.en: Capital of Spain and seat of the royal court. In 1834 it was still a city closed in by walls and gates, governed in the name of the child queen Isabel II by her mother, the regent María Cristina.

en: León Gil de Palacio's model of the city, finished in 1830, is in the Museo de Historia de Madrid
